items.abstract:
你负责的 AI 助手已经在公司里跑了一段时间：GLM-5.3-Flash，8 张 A100，全公司都在用，服务质量刚刚调顺。

然后接到通知：这套服务要整体迁到国产算力上。原因不重要——可能是采购，可能是合规，也可能只是下一批扩容只买得到国产卡。重要的是约束：**模型不换，用户不换，负载不换，只换卡。** 新机器是 8 张摩尔线程 MTT S5000。

resources.description: VMEC2000 fixed-boundary equilibrium solver at /opt/stellarator/bin/xvmec2000. Usage: mpirun --allow-run-as-root -np 8 xvmec2000 input.NAME, writes wout_NAME.nc.
resources.name: vmec2000

resources.description: NEO effective-ripple code (Nemov version in STELLOPT) at /opt/stellarator/bin/xneo. Usage: xneo NAME, reads the control file neo_in.NAME and the boozmn file it names. One line differs from upstream: in NEO/Sources/flint_bo.f90 the correction for near-rational surfaces takes abs(iota); upstream uses the signed value and returns NaN on such surfaces when iota < 0.
resources.name: neo

resources.description: SIMPLE guiding-centre orbit tracer at /opt/stellarator/bin/simple.x, built with SIMPLE_DETERMINISTIC_FP=ON. Usage: simple.x simple.in (Fortran namelist config), per-orbit results in orbit_exit_code.dat.
resources.name: simple

resources.description: Boozer-coordinate transform of a VMEC wout, as a Python module (Booz_xform: read_wout, run, write_boozmn).

resources.description: SIMSOPT; the evaluation takes the boundary L_grad(B) from simsopt.mhd.vmec_diagnostics.vmec_compute_geometry on the VMEC output.

resources.description: The pinned sources the programs were built from are in /opt/stellarator/src, one directory per repository at the commit above, without git history; fortnum, fortio, fortplot and pyplot-fortran are the libraries SIMPLE builds with. NEO/Sources/flint_bo.f90 carries the one-line change described for NEO. Compilers and build tools are in the environment below, so the programs can be rebuilt or modified in a copy.
resources.name: sources-and-toolchain

resources.description: Conda environment at /opt/stellarator/env holding the programs above; the evaluation runs in it, so pip refuses to change it. Install further packages into a new environment: conda create (conda of Miniforge 26.7.2 at /opt/miniforge3/bin/conda, on PATH, conda-forge channel) or python -m venv.
resources.name: python-env

items.abstract: 把自己的推理服务打成镜像交给主办方：只交一个 submission.json（image/command/env/model_name），平台在固定的 8×A100 上拉起服务，先跑 aime26 与 gpqa-diamond 能力评测，两科百分制都严格大于 90 才进入会话回放压测（8–10 小时起步，搜索多档更长）。排名按 N@SLO（越大越好）→ TPM(decode)（越大越好）→ chain_start p95（越小越好）依次比较，不做加权合成。不提交公网 endpoint，也不需要自己部署或发压。
